en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 5. He said: Muhammad ibn Imran al-Marzbani reported to me from Abu Bakr Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa al-Makki, who reported from Abdullah ibn Ahmad ibn Hanbal, who reported from Abdul Rahman ibn Swaleh, who reported from Muhammad ibn Sa’d al-Ansari, who reported from Umar ibn Abdillah Ibn Ya’la ibn Murrah, from his father, from his grandfather Ya’la ibn Murrah, who said: I heard the Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, say to ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him,
"O ‘Ali! You are the master of the people after I have gone. So whoever obeys you, obeys me; and whoever disobeys you, disobeys me."
